_README: Fill in once the arm is rebuilt. The converter refuses real data until gripper_open_deg/gripper_closed_deg are set and confirmed_on_hardware is true.
_joint_zero_deg: Servo angle treated as 0 rad for base, shoulder, elbow. 90 = servo midpoint; any fixed choice works, but it must never change between training and deployment.
_gripper: Confirmed on the EEZYbotARM build 2026-09-19: 40 deg = fully closed, 180 deg = fully open.
_limits: Measured with limit_finder.ino on the EEZYbotARM build, 2026-09-19. Must stay identical to JOINT_MIN / JOINT_MAX in teleop.ino and policy_follower.ino.
